name: monthly_revenue
description: Downstream financial cohort reporting dataset aggregating gross revenue, unit volumes, and net revenue by month and store.

columns.name: month
columns.description: First date of reporting calendar month (YYYY-MM-01).

columns.name: store_id
columns.description: Store outlet identifier associated with revenue cohort.

columns.name: total_orders
columns.description: Total count of order transactions processed in month.

columns.name: total_units
columns.description: Total quantity of item units sold in month.

columns.name: gross_revenue
columns.description: Sum of order quantity times unit price before discounts.

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.description: Total promotional discounts deducted in month.
